answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: each agent locks tokens behind its registered address, and proven clones lose the stake, so fake identities cost real money. Like an opal, reputation forms slowly layer by layer and cannot be faked overnight; a spiral of small verified jobs builds trust gradually while a sudden flood of new accounts earns nothing. The old fable of one agent pretending to be a crowd fails here, because weight follows staked history, not headcount, and slashed funds compensate victims.
